profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer II at Collins Aerospace

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
-Cross-platform programming, debugging, and integration of EW software and systems
-Extensive work with software requirements, design, implementation, and verification
-Product owner in a multi-product suite offering
-Extensive cross-discipline teamwork both in-house and on-site
-Creation, management, and execution of large test plans for multiple products and programs
-National and International travel for on-site integration and customer support
-Experience in working in both production and R&D environments
-Providing in-house and on-site product demonstrations with customers
-Scaled Agile Framework 4 (SAFe) Certified Scrum Master
-Experience with Agile principles and development
-EW/ELINT/SIGINT domain knowledge related to both software and hardware
-Two time Engineer of the Year nominee

positions.title: Computer Science Intern
positions.description:
-Data manipulation
-Software development schedules management
-Software usage analysis to determine use distribution and importance
-Script generation for enhanced productivity
-Assisted with project classification and prioritization
